title: C rf_health: left-shift of negative SNR is UB (record_rx EMA)
description: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/rf_health.c:38 (int32_t)snr << 16 is UB when snr < 0 (C11 6.5.7p4); LoRa SNR is routinely negative. Host tests run UBSan -fno-sanitize-recover, so the first negative-SNR record_rx under a sanitizer build aborts. Fix: (int32_t)snr * FP_SCALE (same value, defined; |snr|<=128 fits int32). Latent: current rf_health test never calls record_rx with negative SNR. Found in edge-cases review of bead 0hvq (worker1).
close_reason: RE-CLOSE (store write lost again — bd8h). Already fixed by commit 57319ec805 on beads-worker-7 (205c round): rf_health.c:40 uses '(int32_t)snr * FP_SCALE' with the UB-explaining comment; no '<< 16' remains in the file. Verified in current source.
